description: Lighting moods by voice. 'Movie time', 'goodnight / I'm going to bed' (Goodnight script), and per room: relax, reading, wind down, night light, evening, brighten up, dim. A mood acts on the room of the device you spoke to, or the room you name ('relax mode in the living room'). Added 2026-11-09.

command: wind down [mode] [in] [the] [living room|lounge|kitchen|bedroom|master bedroom|guest room|guest bedroom|spare room]
night light [mode] [in] [the] [living room|lounge|kitchen|bedroom|master bedroom|guest room|guest bedroom|spare room]
evening (mode|lights) [in] [the] [living room|lounge|kitchen|bedroom|master bedroom|guest room|guest bedroom|spare room]
(brighten up|bright mode|full brightness|make it bright) [in] [the] [living room|lounge|kitchen|bedroom|master bedroom|guest room|guest bedroom|spare room]
(dim mode|dim it down|make it dim|dimmed mode) [in] [the] [living room|lounge|kitchen|bedroom|master bedroom|guest room|guest bedroom|spare room]

variables.here: {% set a = area_id(trigger.device_id) if trigger.device_id else 'bedroom' %}{{ a if a in ['bedroom','kitchen','living_room','guest_bedroom'] else 'bedroom' }}
variables.room: {% set s = trigger.sentence | lower %}{% if 'guest' in s or 'spare' in s %}guest_bedroom{% elif 'living' in s or 'lounge' in s %}living_room{% elif 'kitchen' in s %}kitchen{% elif 'bedroom' in s %}bedroom{% else %}{{ here }}{% endif %}
variables.mood: {% set s = trigger.sentence | lower %}{% if 'read' in s %}reading{% elif 'wind' in s %}wind{% elif 'night' in s %}night{% elif 'evening' in s %}evening{% elif 'welcome' in s %}welcome{% elif 'bright' in s %}bright{% elif 'dim' in s %}dim{% else %}relax{% endif %}

sequence.set_conversation_response: Goodnight. I've turned off the lights and the heat pump.

variables.label: {{ {'bedroom':'the bedroom','kitchen':'the kitchen','living_room':'the living room','guest_bedroom':'the guest room'}[room] }}

then.set_conversation_response: There isn't a {{ {'wind':'wind down','night':'night light'}.get(mood, mood) }} setting for {{ label }}.

sequence.set_conversation_response: {{ {'bright':'Brightened up','dim':'Dimmed the lights','reading':'Reading lights on','wind':'Winding down','relax':'Relax mode','night':'Night light on','evening':'Evening lights on','welcome':'Guest room ready'}[mood] }}{{ '' if room == here else ' in ' ~ label }}.
